title: Fridge Sensor Fault
fullDescription: E1 on Zanussi refrigerators indicates the fridge temperature sensor has failed. Compressor may run constantly.

title: Freezer Sensor Fault
fullDescription: E2 indicates freezer temperature sensor has failed.

title: Evaporator Sensor Fault
fullDescription: E3 means the evaporator temperature sensor used for defrost termination has failed.

title: Defrost Heater Fault
fullDescription: E4 indicates the defrost heater or bi-metal has failed.

title: Fan Fault
fullDescription: E5 indicates circulation fan is not running — iced or electrically failed.

title: Compressor Fault
fullDescription: E6 indicates compressor not starting or overdrawing current.

title: Door Ajar Alarm
fullDescription: E7 indicates door open beyond threshold or failed door switch.

title: Temperature Too High
shortDescription: Interior warmer than setpoint for extended period.
fullDescription: E8 indicates internal temperature has exceeded safe range. Often triggered after a long door-open event or after first switch-on during pulldown.

title: Ice Maker Fault
fullDescription: E9 indicates the ice maker cannot complete its cycle — frozen inlet, failed mould heater, or ejector jam.

title: Control Board Fault
fullDescription: E10 indicates main PCB or EEPROM failure. Power cycle first; otherwise replace board.
